\chapter{Greedy over Bits: Deciding from the Highest Bit}
\label{ch:greedy_bits}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Bit $k$ outweighs all lower bits together, so the best answer is built from the top: fix a bit, check feasibility, go down.}}
\end{tcolorbox}
